title: Implement active prop for animation control
description:
Add support for the active prop (type: boolean, default: true) to control whether the border animation plays. When active=false, the animation should stop/pause. When active=true (default), animation runs indefinitely while card is visible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Component accepts active prop of type boolean
- [ ] Default value is true (animation plays by default)
- [ ] When active=true, border animation runs continuously
- [ ] When active=false, border animation stops/pauses
- [ ] Animation state can be toggled dynamically at runtime
- [ ] Card remains visible and styled when animation is inactive

## Testing Instructions
1. Render <ActivityCard /> - animation should play (default active=true)
2. Render <ActivityCard active={false} /> - animation should NOT play
3. Render <ActivityCard active={true} /> - animation should play
4. Create toggle button to switch active prop - animation should start/stop accordingly
5. Verify card styling remains intact when animation is off
notes: Prop: active: boolean, default: true - Controls animation state

title: Implement color prop for accent customization
description:
Add support for the color prop (type: string, default: #3b82f6) to customize the accent color of the tracing line/glow effect.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Component accepts color prop of type string
- [ ] Default value is #3b82f6 (blue)
- [ ] Color prop changes the animated trail color
- [ ] Color prop affects the glow effect color
- [ ] Supports hex colors (#fff, #ffffff)
- [ ] Supports CSS color names (red, blue, etc.)
- [ ] Supports rgb/rgba values

## Testing Instructions
1. Render <ActivityCard /> - trail should be blue (#3b82f6)
2. Render <ActivityCard color='#ff0000' /> - trail should be red
3. Render <ActivityCard color='green' /> - trail should be green
4. Render <ActivityCard color='rgb(255,0,255)' /> - trail should be magenta
5. Verify glow also changes color to match trail
notes: Prop: color: string, default: #3b82f6 - Accent color of tracing line

title: Implement CSS border animation
description:
Implement the core border tracing animation using pure CSS. A small luminous segment (comet trail) orbits the card perimeter in a smooth continuous loop. Trail has gradient fade - bright at head, transparent at tail. Completes one full loop in ~3 seconds. Trail length is ~25% of perimeter.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Animated trail visibly traces the card's border perimeter
- [ ] Trail has gradient: bright head fading to transparent tail
- [ ] Animation completes full loop in approximately 3 seconds
- [ ] Trail length is approximately 25% of total perimeter
- [ ] Animation runs continuously in infinite loop
- [ ] Implementation uses pure CSS (no JS animation frames or canvas)
- [ ] Uses either conic-gradient with @keyframes OR SVG stroke-dasharray

## Testing Instructions
1. Render card and observe animation visually
2. Time the animation loop with stopwatch (should be ~3s per cycle)
3. Verify trail gradient by pausing animation or screenshot
4. Inspect CSS to confirm no requestAnimationFrame or canvas usage
5. Check animation continues indefinitely (observe for 30+ seconds)
notes: Tech approach: Use conic-gradient mask animated via CSS @keyframes on pseudo-element, OR SVG rect with stroke-dasharray + stroke-dashoffset animation. No canvas, no JS animation frames - pure CSS for performance.
close_reason: Implemented CSS border tracing animation with conic-gradient and @keyframes

title: Implement glow effect on border trail
description:
Add soft glow effect that bleeds inward/outward a few pixels from the animated trail. Creates the pulse/glow feel described in the visual spec.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Glow effect visible around the animated trail
- [ ] Glow bleeds a few pixels inward and outward from trail
- [ ] Glow color matches the trail color (responds to color prop)
- [ ] Glow creates soft, diffused edge (not hard/sharp)
- [ ] Implementation uses box-shadow or filter blur
- [ ] Glow animates with the trail (moves together)

## Testing Instructions
1. Render card and visually inspect for glow around trail
2. Compare trail with and without glow (should have soft halo)
3. Change color prop and verify glow color changes accordingly
4. Inspect CSS to confirm box-shadow or filter:blur implementation
5. Verify glow moves with trail during animation (not static)
notes: Tech: Use box-shadow or filter blur on the trail element
